questions.question: Check the hypotheses in the statement about finite-dimensional commutative real algebras without zero divisors and the two possible conclusions.

questions.question: Separate Weierstrass’s teaching posts: the Progymnasium in Deutsch-Krone (1842–1848) and the Gymnasium in Braunsberg (1848–1855); the current sentence incorrectly combines them into one lower secondary school for fourteen years.
